remarks: Welcome to Anderson Ridge, Unit 22. A bright and spacious three-level townhome located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. Offering approximately 1,384 square feet of living space, this well-maintained home combines comfort, functionality, and community amenities in a prime location walkable to the water!  Property Highlights * 3 bedrooms | 2 full baths | 1 half bath - plenty of space for families, guests, or a home office setup with a newly Updated Kitchen. * An airy, sunlit living area that flows into the dining space, creating an inviting layout for everyday living and entertaining. * A finished lower level with flexible space for a recreation room, home gym, or playroom. * Convenient in-unit laundry for everyday ease.  Community & Lifestyle * Residents enjoy access to an on-site clubhouse and a refreshing pool, perfect for summer relaxation. * Includes reserved parking plus ample visitor spaces. * Professionally managed, well-cared-for complex.  Location Set in the charming Glenbrook section of Stamford, this townhome offers a neighborhood feel with the convenience of city living. Just minutes from I-95, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and downtown Stamford, you'll have quick access to both local amenities, beaches and an easy commute to New York City.  Whether you're a first-time buyer, a growing family, or seeking an investment property, Unit 22 is a rare opportunity to own a spacious home in a sought-after Stamford community.
